name: frontend-design
description: Designs and implements a consistent, accessible, mobile-first storefront.
---
# Frontend Design Skill
1. Inspect existing brand styles, layout and components before designing.
2. Prioritize catalog clarity, product imagery, readable pricing and visible purchase actions.
3. Establish consistent spacing, typography, color, borders and component states.
4. Design mobile-first navigation, product cards, cart and checkout.
5. Check semantic HTML, focus, keyboard navigation, contrast, labels and touch target size.
6. Include empty, loading, success and error states.
7. Do not invent product facts or modify stored product/pricing data.
